signalSession lifetime is page id. The constructor reads no reactive data; page id is an intentional lifecycle invalidation key even though absent from the factory body. PageCanvas coordinates a page-id-scoped signal session, tab/page-scoped coordinator, measurements and runtime slots. Runtime slot/width/auto-height modules already own sub-responsibilities. The page change clears measurement epochs and creates a fresh batch, while block changes update the retained coordinator instead of disposing active sessions. The coordinator lifetime is tab/page/sharedCoordinator/signalSession; a following updateBlocks effect reconciles changing runtime blocks.
